items.headline: NVIDIA released Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B, an open-weights image model with 3B active parameters
items.excerpt: NVIDIA released open weights for Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B on Hugging Face on 26 November, an image model with 30 billion total and 3 billion active parameters.

items.headline: Google's Cogentic posted six math papers and OpenAI claimed matrix multiplication exponent 9/4
items.excerpt: Google Research posted six math papers on 25 November, produced by its Cogentic multi-agent system, including a claimed unconditional factoring algorithm in time L_N[1/3, O(1)].

items.headline: Meta launched its Muse agent in the UK and inside Instagram DMs
items.excerpt: Meta launched its Muse AI agent in the UK on 24 November for users aged 18 and over, with Sainsbury's, Argos, Marks & Spencer and other retail and travel partners.

items.headline: Anthropic launched Claude Ship, beta agents that fix and approve GitHub pull requests
items.excerpt: Anthropic launched Claude Ship on 23 November, adding two beta agents that let Claude fix failing pull requests and approve routine ones on GitHub.

items.headline: NVIDIA released Alpamayo 2 Edge, an open driving model for DRIVE AGX Thor
items.excerpt: NVIDIA released Alpamayo 2 Edge on 22 November, an open-weights reasoning vision-language-action model with a 2.45B backbone built to run on the DRIVE AGX Thor computer inside a car.

items.headline: NVIDIA released Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, 14 open diffusion language model checkpoints at 3B and 8B
items.excerpt: NVIDIA released Nemotron-Labs-Sigma on 20 November, a family of 14 open-weights checkpoints at 3B and 8B parameters that form a continuous diffusion language model.
